items.title: Spark TV moving logo (network ident)
items.about: 20 s moving logo: a montage of our channels' clips into the Spark Flower. Plays once an hour before a programme on every Spark channel.
items.credit: Our own ad. Music: "Inspiring Advertising" by Rafael Krux, CC BY 4.0. Clips: Blender Foundation (CC BY), public domain, Spark TV.

items.title: Spark TV network montage
items.about: 30 s montage: shows through petal windows, rapid-fire words, a 3x3 wall flying into the flower. In the breaks of every channel.
items.credit: Our own ad. Music: "Inspiring Advertising" by Rafael Krux, CC BY 4.0. Clips: Blender Foundation (CC BY), public domain, Spark TV.

items.title: Spark TV montage 2, channel surfing
items.about: 20 s montage: shows glide past on a carousel, faster and faster, then sliding strips into the flower. In the breaks of every channel (owner picked the news clock 2026-10-10).
items.credit: Our own ad. Music: "Inspiring Advertising" by Rafael Krux, CC BY 4.0. Clips: Blender Foundation (CC BY), public domain, Spark TV.

items.title: Spark TV montage 3, the remote
items.about: 20 s montage: a TV flips through the Spark channels faster and faster, the channel list scrolls, the TV switches off to a dot that blooms into the flower. In the breaks of every channel (owner picked the news clock 2026-10-10).
items.credit: Our own ad. Music: "Inspiring Advertising" by Rafael Krux, CC BY 4.0. Clips: Blender Foundation (CC BY), public domain, Spark TV.

items.title: Spark TV montage 4, every screen
items.about: 20 s montage: one show pulls back into hundreds of screens that turn into the Spark Flower. In the breaks of every channel (owner picked the news clock 2026-10-10).
items.credit: Our own ad. Music: "Inspiring Advertising" by Rafael Krux, CC BY 4.0. Clips: Blender Foundation (CC BY), public domain, Spark TV.

items.title: Spark TV montage 5, rhythm panels
items.about: 20 s montage from real footage only: slanted panels split the screen on the beat, a wall of 16 screens flips, four columns close into the flower. In the breaks of every channel (owner picked the news clock 2026-10-10).
items.credit: Our own ad. Music: "Inspiring Advertising" by Rafael Krux, CC BY 4.0. Clips: Spark TV News footage (Wikimedia Commons), Blender Foundation (CC BY), public domain.

items.title: Spark TV montage 6, four languages
items.about: 20 s montage: one TV, four languages. A wall in the Urdu, Hindi, English and Punjabi colours, each language full screen in turn, folding into the flower. In the breaks of every channel (owner picked the news clock 2026-10-10).
items.credit: Our own ad. Music: "Inspiring Advertising" by Rafael Krux, CC BY 4.0. Clips: Blender Foundation (CC BY), Spark TV News footage (Wikimedia Commons), Spark TV.

items.title: Spark TV montage 7, calm gallery
items.about: 20 s montage from real footage only: big postcards glide in one after another, then four cards slide together into the flower. In the breaks of every channel (owner picked the news clock 2026-10-10).
items.credit: Our own ad. Music: "Inspiring Advertising" by Rafael Krux, CC BY 4.0. Clips: Spark TV News footage (Wikimedia Commons), Blender Foundation (CC BY), public domain.

items.title: Spark News opener, headlines
items.about: 20 s news opener from real news footage only: the news clock: a clock face (NEWS / خبریں) sweeps to twelve while four windows open around it (Toronto, Mumbai, sports, weather, each labelled in English + Urdu), then SPARK NEWS HEADLINES / اسپارک نیوز کی سرخیاں. Opens every headlines bulletin (owner picked the news clock 2026-10-10).
items.credit: Our own ad. Music: "Inspiring Advertising" by Rafael Krux, CC BY 4.0. Clips: Spark TV News footage (Wikimedia Commons).

items.title: Spark News opener, full news
items.about: 20 s news opener from real news footage only: the news clock: a clock face (NEWS / خبریں) sweeps to twelve while four windows open around it (Toronto, Mumbai, sports, weather, each labelled in English + Urdu), then SPARK NEWS / اسپارک نیوز. Opens every full news bulletin (owner picked the news clock 2026-10-10).
items.credit: Our own ad. Music: "Inspiring Advertising" by Rafael Krux, CC BY 4.0. Clips: Spark TV News footage (Wikimedia Commons).
